## Module

Example:
- Cashier/POS
- Inventory
- Finance
- Stock Opname
- Purchasing

## Goal

Explain the feature goal.

## User Role

Who will use this feature?

## Access Rules

Who can view, create, update, delete?

## Data Needed

List tables, fields, or forms.

## UI Requirement

Explain expected page or layout.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Feature works
- [ ] Access control works
- [ ] Existing modules are not broken
- [ ] UI follows existing BreadLab style
